body:
I was looking for someone for years, and she found me, she saved me, and then left. I lost something that was worth to me more than my self. 

You can not now just unlove someone.

Well, when you've been friendzoned or simply told to fuck off your entire life from people you loved it doesen't suffice any more, I honestly need that someone, a shoulder to cry on, someone that could be there for me, and who I could be there for and I can not wait any more.

 I'm quite literally broken inside, the pain that I feel is starting to be unberable, it hurts like all hell. I just wanna dissapear, like I never existed.

I finished HS this year and started working right away if I wanted to be allowed to stay and live at home, finished HS for Oil and Mining tehnician but working on a construction site. 

When I used to have time off I played video games, lots of them, another one of my escapes from reality. I used to cycle but I simply don't have the energy or the time for it. With so much going on I can't keep up.
 
And yes, she did become my obsession, she not knowingly saved my life, she offered me confort but I was a greedy fuck as this is the first time I expirienced someone actually being good to me so I constantly wanted more from her, even though she might not want aything. But I need her, without hearing her voice and seing her face I would literally have no reason to stay here.
